description.value: Maple Palace Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant in Sidney, BC, run under new management and helmed by a chef born and raised in China with over 20 years of experience. The dining room is decorated with hand-painted murals and offers a unique view of aircraft taking off from nearby Victoria International Airport. The menu spans classic Cantonese staples through Szechuan and Mongolian dishes, with both dine-in and takeout available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record: phone 778-426-3288 and address 202-9800 McDonald Park Road, Sidney, V8L 1W7 both match. The website explicitly mentions takeout ('grabbing some take-out or sitting in our unique dining room') and vegetarian options ('a variety of delicious vegetarian options'), while no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, pump, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website text.
concerns: OSM name is 'Maple Palace' but the business consistently refers to itself as 'Maple Palace Restaurant' on its website; OSM value retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Chinese restaurant with confirmed operating hours and a full menu; a useful stop for touring cyclists in the Sidney area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'We also offer a variety of delicious vegetarian options.' No vegan or GF claims made
